rizzi.s: a bare foot lifted out of turquoise shallows with a spiky black urchin clamped to the sole, the swimmer's face scrunched mid-yelp

ghadira.s: a solid packed wall of beach umbrellas edge to edge, one lone towel squeezed into the single bare patch of sand between them

kajakk.s: a bright plastic kayak drifting sideways, the paddler slumped forward clutching one shoulder, the paddle floating away out of reach

bagni.s: a lone striped sunbed roped off with velvet cord on bare public rock, a lido attendant's open palm held out beside it

kurrent.s: a tiny swimmer far out on open water, one arm raised in a cheery hopeful wave, a distant island on the horizon

klamari.s: a plate of golden battered rings, one stretched long and rubbery between a raised fork and the plate, refusing to snap

gozoferry.s: a family camped beside their car on a harbour quay with folding chairs, parasol and cool box, the ferry tiny far offshore

bahri.s: a weathered old sea captain in a peaked cap, arms flung wide to show an impossible wave height, flat calm water behind

blue.s: a boatman standing in a small painted boat sweeping one arm grandly toward a rock arch, his passengers already looking the other way

mewga.s: a beach parasol cartwheeling high through the air over the water, one lone hand below grabbing at nothing, sand streaming sideways

sirena.s: a mermaid in a scaled shell top perched on a rock, one arm hugging a stolen cool box, holding out sunglasses pityingly

wattsapp.s: a phone buzzing violently on a pillow, radiating rings of sound, a limp hand flopping out from under a duvet to swat it

kuntu.s: a picked-clean lobster shell on one plate, a folded blank slip on a saucer, and every hand at the table suddenly reaching elsewhere

ghajn.s: a blue glass eye charm hanging in a doorway glaring downward, below it a car with its bonnet up gently steaming

tieg.s: one lone guest in a suit at a huge round banquet table, nine empty chairs around him, cutlery untouched, still waiting

kugin.s: a beaming man in a vest giving a thumbs-up beside a battered van, a sofa hanging out the back doors, snapped table leg underfoot

kunjatu.s: a stone-faced old man folded into an armchair, arms crossed, mouth just beginning to open, everyone else in the room leaning back

gossip.s: three neighbours on a doorstep bench whispering ear to ear in a chain, the last one already turning to stare at the viewer

debtor.s: a grinning man waving cheerfully with one hand, the other hand held behind his back completely empty and strung with cobwebs

skiet.s: a woman at a kitchen table staring hard at the wall, arms folded, sliding a plate across toward a hand frozen mid-reach

spiter.s: a raw concrete block wall shoved a metre over a low garden wall, crushing a lemon tree, a wheeled suitcase abandoned on the path

vat.s: a calm suited inspector behind a mountain of curled blank paper slips, slowly rolling one sleeve up, settling in for the whole afternoon

kinnie.s: a tall glass of dark orange fizz crowned with a bitter orange slice, a tourist's hand recoiling mid-sip, lips puckered tight

sptar.s: a man alone on a long row of plastic bucket chairs holding up a bandaged swollen foot, stubble grown long, slumped and waiting

pastizz.s: two flaky diamond pastries on greaseproof paper, one oozing white filling and one green, a single hand snatching both at once

bajtra.s: a small bottle of magenta prickly pear liqueur set down by robed hands, varnish blistering and peeling off the table beneath it

ftira.s: an enormous crusty ring loaf packed with tuna, olives and onion, gripped in two small hands, drooping eyelids just visible behind it

xita.s: a small car ploughing down a flooded street throwing a huge sheet of water over a doorway, the driver serenely unbothered at the wheel

bonu.s: a blank paper slip sprouting little wings, fluttering straight out of an open palm toward a shop doorway, coins trailing behind it

siesta.s: a man jolting bolt upright on a sofa, hair flattened on one side, cushion pattern printed across his cheek, wild-eyed and sweating

pjazza.s: an old man on a square bench pointing sideways at a second old man, who is already pointing further on down the street

tapit.s: a stiff broom shoving an enormous straining lump under an ornate rug, dust puffing out, one corner of the rug lifting on its own

kuntatt.s: a hand cupping an old telephone receiver secretively while a second hand slides a plain brown envelope across the table beneath it

warden.s: a uniformed traffic warden stepping out from behind a parked van holding a small blank pad, a driver frozen mid-step beside his car

qattus.s: a smug cat sitting squarely in the middle of a gleaming car bonnet, a trail of dusty paw prints tracked across the fresh paint

skuza.s: a man arriving late in a doorway, palms spread wide in apology, behind him through the door a completely empty open road

dawl.s: a rear-view mirror washed with blue glow, three passengers behind frozen mid-laugh, every hand snapping a seatbelt across at once

bolla.s: an enormous blank-faced rubber stamp slamming down on a table, a leather wallet squashed pancake-flat beneath it, coins squirting out sideways

ncempel.s: a man walking away, glancing back over his shoulder making a cheery thumb-and-little-finger call-me gesture, eyes already somewhere else entirely

lift.s: a man collapsed halfway up a bare concrete stairwell hugging a huge water bottle and shopping bags, staring up at endless flights above

ommok.s: a tiny shrunken grown man in a shirt cringing on a kitchen table under an enormous wagging finger looming down from above

sparkler.s: a small child gleefully swinging a fizzing sparkler, behind him a merry red-faced father slumped in a plastic chair giving a lazy thumbs-up

bandalora.s: a faded tattered plain cloth banner sagging on a rope strung between two balconies, one end unravelled, a pigeon perched smugly on it

qniepen.s: two huge bronze bells swinging wildly in a stone belfry, a small determined figure hauling the rope below, startled birds exploding outward

girandola.s: a spinning firework wheel leaping off its wooden post trailing sparks, veering low toward the viewer, a flat cap flying off below

tromba.s: a lone bandsman straining upward at a raised trumpet, eyes squeezed shut, two listeners below wincing with fingers jammed in their ears

president.s: a portly man in a sash gripping the armrests of an ornate carved chair, one polished shoe planted firmly on a plain wooden ballot box

salut.s: a man mid-flinch in a deckchair, his cup launching out of his hand, a fresh puff of smoke rising over the rooftops behind

surmast.s: an ancient bandmaster on a podium, baton raised like a sword, enormous white moustache bristling, glaring down over a worn tailcoat

bombi.s: a village rooftop skyline under a sky of bursting fireworks, below a car with headlights flashing and a howling dog on a balcony

naghga.s: a single sheep standing squarely in the middle of a narrow country lane chewing calmly, a car nose skewed onto the verge behind it

patata.s: a crate of earthy unwashed potatoes on a van tailgate, the seller offering one forward while turning his face away, shrugging evasively

karettun.s: a sagging pickup piled impossibly high with tomato crates, two dogs perched on top, a young man standing upright in the back holding nothing

frawli.s: a heaped basket of strawberries in the foreground, behind it a thin snaking line of tiny cars winding away over a hill

bir.s: a crumbling stone wellhead with a bucket dangling into dry dust and cobwebs, a proud owner patting its rim possessively

hmar.s: a donkey planted flat on a dusty track, rope pulled taut, a farmer heaving at the far end with his heels skidding

bettieha.s: a battered van piled with watermelons, a horn speaker on its roof blaring visible sound ripples, shutters slamming shut above the street

klieb.s: two lean hunting dogs straining shoulder to shoulder on taut leads, ears flat back, front paws lifting off the dirt, tongues out
